title: Robinson's record sessions after Sam Morgan
summary: He lists records with Kid Rena, Kid Howard and Peter Bocage, and with Rudi Blesh, made in 1946.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now

blocks.x: So he played violin here in the city too. Oh yeah. Let's see. You made the Sam Morgan recording. Then what was the next recording after that?
I made a recording with Rainey. Mm-hmm. Kid Rainey. That's the next recording. What recording else I made after that?
You know Harrison Barnes told me, I mean Harrison Brasley, told me he's supposed to make those records but he couldn't do it.
And I made a recording, I made a recording with, with, uh, with, uh, Kid Howard, Peter Bucca, Rudy Blush.
Mm-hmm. And I made a recording, then the next recording I made with Bill Russell.
Mm-hmm. No, you made the ones with Bill, but we made the ones with Rudy.
Oh yeah, of course. Oh yeah, yeah. Yeah, that's right. Yeah, I sure did.

Oh Rudy Blush ever came from town. Yeah, yeah, yeah, that's right. I'm sure of that. Rudy came, came, came, came here in 40, in 47 for, for a convo. Mm-hmm. Yeah, we made it, in 46, 46, yeah, Rudy came to the, yeah, but we, we, we, we was up there in 45, you know. And we came back, Rudy Blush came, came here, that, year, that next year for convo, and we made his records, you understand? That was 46, 46, I remember, yeah.
